title: India news: Long queues hit stores as new iPhones go on sale
summary: The iPhone 18 has gone on sale in India, drawing huge queues across the country. Meanwhile, the Election Commission has barred both Trinamool factions from using the party's name in by-elections.…

image.caption: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max went on sale in India on FridayImage: Carlos Barria/REUTERS

blocks.text: The iPhone 18 has gone on sale in India, drawing huge queues across the country. Meanwhile, the Election Commission has barred both Trinamool factions from using the party's name in by-elections. Follow DW for more.

blocks.caption: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max went on sale in India on FridayImage: Carlos Barria/REUTERS

items: The new iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max have hit the Indian markets, leading to long queues outside stores
The Election Commission has barred both factions of the Trinamool Congress from using the party name and symbol in upcoming bypolls
Cricket's global governing body is eyeing new viewership, this time from China

blocks.caption: The baby orangutans were found in an Odisha forest, far from their natural habitatImage: ANI/IMAGO

blocks.text: Five infant orangutans, a species found only on the Indonesian island of Sumatra and on Borneo, were found in a forest by rangers patrolling in the Balasore district of India's eastern Odisha state last week.
In recent years, orangutans, rare reptiles and other exotic animals are popping up in India, suggesting the country is becoming a major destination for trafficked wildlife.
